subject: Follow-up: security questionnaire kickoff & encryption/dataflow clarifications
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morris <alex.morris@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: security questionnaire kickoff & encryption/dataflow clarifications

Alex — thanks again for the time on today's call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have aligned expectations: 

Recap of what we covered:
- Narrowed scope to vendor security questionnaire (SIG-lite preferred on your side) and a short HIPAA attestation for the workloads you plan to send to the hosted API.
- You confirmed SOC 2 Type II in progress (audit in Q3), and primary residency requirement is US (some EU SSO routing later).
- Key asks you raised: encryption at rest key ownership, KMS residency, evidence for key rotation and access controls, and timeline for questionnaire completion.

Clarifying questions from our side (so we can prefill the right fields):
1) For HIPAA scope — will NexaHealth be sending PHI directly to our hosted API, or will you proxy/encrypt before transmission? (affects our recommended deployment path)
2) For encryption keys — do you require customer-managed keys (CMKs) in your own KMS/HSM, or is Nexa comfortable with Redwood-managed keys with proof of rotation and separation of duties?
3) Are there specific regulatory controls beyond HIPAA/GDPR (state-level, e.g., CCPA) we should account for in evidence mapping?
4) Timeline: can you confirm a target date for questionnaire completion? You mentioned ~3 weeks during the call.

What I can send now:
- Redwood SOC 2 summary (attached) and a short SIG-prefill guide that explains which SIG/CAIQ fields we can prefill with current artifacts.
- A lightweight KMS architecture diagram so your security team can see our key handling options.

Proposed next steps:
- If SIG-lite is acceptable, we will prefill the bulk of the CAIQ fields and flag items that need evidence.
- Camila (cc'd, security lead) will own evidence collection and will reach out for any proof artifacts.
- Please confirm whether procurement/legal should be added to the thread (I can loop them in).

If you want, I can also share a short checklist that maps SIG questions to attachments we can provide; that tends to speed reviews.

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, sig-prefill-instructions.pdf, kms-architecture-diagram.png

From: Alex Morris <alex.morris@nexahealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nexahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 15:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: security questionnaire kickoff & encryption/dataflow clarifications

Sergio — really helpful, thanks for the summary. A few quick answers and clarifications from our side: 

1) HIPAA scope: yes, we will be sending PHI to the API for document redaction in the short term. We plan to test with de-identified data but will move to live PHI by pilot start.
2) Encryption/KMS: we prefer customer-managed keys for production (we run keys in AWS KMS with restricted cross-account access). For the pilot we can accept Redwood-managed keys if we document rotation policy and have an audit trail.
3) Other regs: we need to be mindful of CCPA/CPRA obligations for some subsets of records — but primary scope is HIPAA and SOC 2.
4) Timeline: target 3 weeks is accurate for procurement + security review if we can get prefill + evidence within 5 business days.

Couple of asks for you: 
- Can you confirm what artifacts you can provide proactively (policy docs, network diagrams, SOC 2 summary)?
- For CMK support, do you support KMS cross-account roles, or would we need to host keys in our account and have Redwood request access?

I copied procurement so they can drop in any contract-related constraints. If possible, please loop in your security engineering lead so technical evidence exchange can start.

Thanks —
Alex Morris
Head of Product Security
NexaHealth
alex.morris@nexahealth.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morris <alex.morris@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@nexahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: security questionnaire kickoff & encryption/dataflow clarifications

Alex — great, thanks for the clarity. Short answers and proposed plan below.

Artifacts we can proactively provide (attached and link to shared drive):
- SOC 2 summary and control mapping (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf)
- Network and KMS architecture diagram (kms-architecture-diagram.png)
- Data retention & incident response policies (we can extract targeted pages for your review)

KMS/CMK approach options:
- Option A (preferred for Nexa production): Customer-managed CMKs in your AWS account — Redwood will request a limited cross-account role for encryption/decryption. We have an established cross-account approach and a short onboarding checklist; that keeps key material under your control.
- Option B (pilot / faster): Redwood-managed keys with documented rotation and audit logs. We can provide rotation policy, KMS logs, and access control lists as evidence.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) We will start a SIG-lite prefill using the attachments above and flag any items requiring your evidence. Expect the first prefill by EOD Wednesday (3 business days).
2) Camila will own evidence collection — she will reach out with a short list of documents we need (e.g., rotation policy, IAM role ARN for KMS if Option A).
3) Procurement — can you confirm any SOW/contractual timelines or redline owners we should be prepared for?

If that works, I'll schedule a 30-min follow-up with Camila + your security engineer this week to go over the prefill and confirm owners.

Best —
Sergio

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Morris <alex.morris@nexahealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@nexahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: NexaHealth SIG prefill — evidence owners and next actions

Camila / Ben — quick internal note to align on responsibilities for NexaHealth (NEXA-8341):

Camila — please take primary ownership of evidence collection and act as the security SME on calls. High-priority items to request:
- KMS key rotation policy & proof of rotation logs (last 12 months)
- SOC 2 control mapping (we'll attach our summary)
- Network segmentation diagram for hosted API (we'll provide base diagram)

Ben — please coordinate on pricing/contract lane; procurement may request CMK support language and a short-term pilot SLA exception. If procurement asks for contractual language for cross-account roles, you'll handle the first pass.

I will:
- Start the SIG-lite prefill today and drop the prefilled doc into the shared drive link (see HubSpot/Drive links in top-level email).
- Schedule follow-up with Alex + their security engineer for Wed 11am PT unless you prefer another time.

Notes: target is to have prefill + initial evidence collection started within 3 business days so procurement can run legal review on their 3-week timeline.

Thanks —
Sergio

[Internal only: Camila, please add any additional evidence asks you want me to include in the prefill ticket before I upload. Ben — flag any commercial constraints you think procurement will push back on.]
